metadata.title: Verify final integrated build with bounded disposable dependencies

spec.objective: Run independent invariant tests and production build on exact published source. This gate covers service/client and UI packaging, not SBF execution or live devnet. Install dependencies into the disposable worker checkout, use an external npm cache, then remove only that generated dependency directory after checks so the result receipt remains bounded. Never remove or alter application source.
acceptance: UI typecheck and production bundle succeed
Exact source commit and genuine worker receipt retained
